_comment: FR-TR-008 环向动量 / 转动通道 —— 2026-09-18。门：$FYLITE_KERNEL 的 transport.rs 与 tests/test_momentum_channel_code.py

interface.kernel: transport::solve_momentum(rho, omega_init, vprime, gm3, r2, dens, mass, chi_phi, pinch: Option<&[f64]>, torque, dt, edge, ...)
interface.equation: d(M_I omega)/dt + (1/V') d/drho [ -M chi_phi domega/drho + M v_phi omega ] = torque,  M = V' <|grad rho|^2> n m <R^2>
interface.descriptor: ChannelDescriptor name "momentum" on the ETS canonical form (FR-TR-001)
interface.door: code/evolve: momentum = 1; optional fylite:chi_turb_phi (replaces chi_phi = prandtl * chi_i) and fylite:v_phi (the pinch); refused by name without the channel
interface.turbulent_closure: code/turbulence (extension), setting momentum_flux = 1 (default off): chi_phi = chi_GB |Pi/Pi_GB| / ((R/a) |vpar_shear| (n_i m_i)/(n_e m_ref)), Pi_GB = n_e T_e a (rho_s/a)^2; refused without a rotation profile
interface.dd_names: core_transport/model/*/profiles_1d/momentum_phi/{d, v} (DD 4.1.1; the SRS's momentum_tor is the DD 3 spelling)

pinch_closed_form.case: chi = 2, v = -1.5, T = 4, edge = 1000; omega = C e^{kx} + (T/v) x + T chi / v^2

default_parity: momentum_flux off: test_the_turbulent_tier_with_rotation_equals_the_loop_to_the_bit and the page parity unchanged
not_covered: residual stress / intrinsic rotation (a pinch profile must be supplied; TGLF's convective part is not separated from its diffusive part)
the turbulent chi_phi reaches the march the way chi_turb does: the host binds the turbulence door's answer into code/evolve block by block (no in-door TGLF call)
